DLC2322:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $n. Your training is as grueling as ever.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:6.en:
$n
「The battles ahead will be in space... Deep space, at that. There's no end to what we need to do to prepare.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... Rather than getting carried away with our victories so far, you are looking ahead.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to lend a hand as well.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:9.en:
$n
「Are you going to spar with me?」

DLC2322:3:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... You are looking at me as though I am prey to be hunted...」

DLC2322:3:t_1:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I shall assist in a way only I can.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I have prepared a fiendish simulator packed with powerful enemies. And this one is set in space.」

DLC2322:3:t_1:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since this is training, most of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s event control will be disabled...」

DLC2322:3:t_1:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I have specially prepared ten A-Adapters, so please use them when preparing to deploy.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How was that, $n? Good training, wasn't it?」

DLC2322:3:t_2:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Still, I'd rather not imagine all those enemies attacking at once.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying, $$セツコ$$? What awaits us may be enemies even stronger than those.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you lose your nerve over that much, you will never survive the fierce battles to come.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I realize all too well how naive I've been.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, to give you a little more guidance on that point, let us head to your room...」

DLC2322:3:t_2:14.en:
$n
「It sounds like $$ＡＧ$$'s sexual harassment is your greatest enemy, $$セツコ$$.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「No matter how powerful the enemy, anything is better than that.」

DLC2322:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right! Now that our resolve is firm, let us prepare for the next battle!」

DLC2322:3:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone! Thank you for your hard work!」

DLC2322:4:t_000:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Expecting tact from that robot is pointless.」

DLC2322:4:t_000:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, now... Please direct your anger at the enemy instead of me.」

DLC2322:4:t_000:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have prepared opponents worthy of the occasion.」

DLC2322:4:t_001:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...! And Captain $$アンジェロ$$, too!」

DLC2322:4:t_001:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「He's even recreated the $$ネオ・ジオング$$ from data!?」

DLC2322:4:t_001:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The $$タイタン変動重力源$$ is here too!」

DLC2322:4:t_001:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I never thought we'd have to fight that thing again...!」

DLC2322:4:t_001:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That black $$アクエリオン$$...! It's the one $$ミカゲ$$ used!」

DLC2322:4:t_001:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Fighting the black $$アクエリオン$$ while we have the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ on our side... That's something only a simulation could do.」

DLC2322:4:t_001:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Even $$ストライカー#pilot$$ is here.」

DLC2322:4:t_001:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「And surrounding them are $$バジュラ$$ and...」

DLC2322:4:t_001:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How is that for a star-studded lineup?」

DLC2322:4:t_001:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, everyone! Let us give this our all!」

DLC2322:4:t_003:1.en:
$$シン$$
「We can't lose to someone we've already fought once.」

DLC2322:4:t_003:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's right. We've grown stronger too.」

DLC2322:4:t_003:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But the universe is vast... Do not forget that the enemies you are likely to encounter will be beyond imagination.」

DLC2322:4:t_100:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
（$$フル・フロンタル$$... Having rejected you, we'll move into the future with our own potential... our own strength...!）

DLC2322:4:t_100:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
（We believe in the light...! And we'll seize it with our own hands!）

DLC2322:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
（$$アンジェロ$$... I never expected to fight you like this...）

DLC2322:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
（Sorry, but I don't have time for you anymore! Especially when you're nothing but data!）

DLC2322:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
（Once we're out in the galaxy, there'll probably be $$宇宙怪獣$$ like this everywhere...!）

DLC2322:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
（But we have to do it...! What can I do to help...?）

DLC2322:4:t_103:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
（Even $$宇宙怪獣$$ evolve...）

DLC2322:4:t_103:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
（Even $$宇宙怪獣$$ evolve...）

DLC2322:4:t_103:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
（What are $$宇宙怪獣$$, really...? Is it truly impossible to communicate with them...?）

DLC2322:4:t_103:4.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
（What are $$宇宙怪獣$$, really...? Is it truly impossible to communicate with them...?）

DLC2322:4:t_103:5.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
（What are $$宇宙怪獣$$, really...? Is it truly impossible to communicate with them...?）

DLC2322:4:t_104:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$アクエリオン$$ versus $$アクエリオン$$... This feels weird!」

DLC2322:4:t_104:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
（Come and get us, $$ミカゲ$$! Whatever tricks you pull, we're not gonna lose!）

DLC2322:4:t_105:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
（This $$アクエリオン$$ was born from $$ミカゲ$$'s hatred...!）

DLC2322:4:t_105:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
（Even if it's nothing but data, we can't afford to lose!）

DLC2322:4:t_106:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$. What are $$ストライカー#pilot$$'s performance specifications?」

DLC2322:4:t_106:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I estimate that the data was created based on the battle in the $$霧の海$$.」

DLC2322:4:t_106:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Then we can't lose...! We've already beaten it once!」

DLC2322:4:t_106:3.en:
$$レド$$
「We're even stronger than we were back then. We shouldn't fall behind!」

review.context: A space-based boss simulator prepares the team for deep-space combat. AG harasses Setsuko, while pilots reflect on simulated enemies from their past battles.
decisions: AG sexual harassment is explicitly named, matching the source.
Boss in Space remains an event title, not the Boss pilot.
Nono thoughts retain all three form-specific records.
